title: Live writer provisioning bounded parallelism
purpose: Reduce reset-before-run live benchmark setup time by provisioning load-test writer account/policy pairs concurrently, while preserving serial behavior by default.
notes: The concurrency implementation is chunked and does not require bash wait -n, so it is compatible with older macOS bash.
Each seed job writes an isolated log under the script work directory. On failure, the first 160 lines of each failed seed log are printed.
Default remains serial to preserve historical behavior. Live green runs should opt in with LOADTEST_SEED_CONCURRENCY=8 or 16 and log the chosen value.
next_move: Run item273 cached live ladder with deterministic writer seed, payload cache, and LOADTEST_SEED_CONCURRENCY=16. If provisioning fails under concurrency, lower to 8 and log the failure mode.
